charge_port.notes: Lexus USA: 2026 RZ adopts the NACS (SAE J3400) port (US).
Lexus Canada: 2026 model BEVs come with the NACS port (Canada).

supercharger_access.notes: US: more than 25,000 NACS plugs via the Tesla Supercharger Network for 2026 RZ owners.
Canada: Lexus BEV guests can charge on the Tesla Supercharger Network; 2026 RZ and ES also get Plug & Charge.

wheels.notes: US Premium AWD w/18 in standard. Per data/variants: Signature = US Premium (18 in standard, 20 in option), Luxury = US Luxury (20 in only).

US Premium AWD w/20 in option (2026 Premium page shows 18 in only; 20 in option carried from earlier years). Per data/variants: Signature = US Premium (18 in standard, 20 in option), Luxury = US Luxury (20 in only).
